explanation: Clipping the cystic duct before achieving the Critical View of Safety transitions the operation to clipping-and-cutting while placing the common bile duct at high risk, consistent with all retrieved cases (VID92_00689, VID96_00956, VID62_01091, VID79_01617, VID01_00698). None of the matched transitions resulted in bleeding, and the surgeon most commonly followed by retracting the gallbladder (VID62_01091, VID79_01617) or clipping the exposed cystic artery (VID92_00689, VID96_00956).
